cards.hint: Think about which force is larger.
options: in the direction of the greater force
in the direction of the smaller force
cards.quote: If the forces become unbalanced, the aircraft will move in the direction of the greater force.
cards.stem: What happens when forces on an aircraft become unbalanced?

cards.hint: Recall which forces pair in level flight.
options: the weight would be balanced by the lift
the weight would be balanced by the thrust
the drag would be balanced by the lift
cards.quote: the weight would be balanced by the lift and the drag would be balanced by the thrust.
cards.stem: In steady level cruise, which pairing shows balanced forces?

cards.hint: Compare lift and weight for vertical motion.
cards.stem: If weight is decreased while lift is held constant, what occurs?

cards.hint: Compare thrust and drag for forward motion.
cards.stem: When thrust is increased while drag stays constant, what occurs?
